question: Does every built packet contain everything a filing needs, or only everything the build chose to write?
whatTheOldPassProved: That every write was correct: bound to exact source bytes, inside a measured box, off every protected field. It never asked what was owed, so a family could pass having written 6 of 187 fields.
passRule: A family returns PASS_COMPLETE only when all 9 counters are zero: knownRequiredFieldsMissing, requiredFactsNotCollected, unclassifiedBlanks, incompleteRows, requiredOptionsMissing, requiredComponentsMissing, invisibleWrites, protectedWrites, visualDefects.
